social_formats.description: Performed in sets, typical of Scottish country dance, historically at hunt balls.

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Longwise sets (standard for Scottish country dance)
movement_profile.tempo_feel: Considerably slower than a standard reel

music_profile.sound_description: A G major tune that functions as a rant but is played at a slower, more deliberate tempo suitable for a Scottish measure in 2/4 time.

teaching.level_notes: The sources indicate it was a popular social dance at formal balls, suggesting a level accessible to social dancers of the period.
